milestone: Collection — Theme-Scoped, Deduplicated Asset Registry (Phase 2: Collection-aware picker)
slice: Implements Phase 2 of the approved Collection plan -- replaces the plain _assetUploadRow calls for an Experience's Image ('Photo') and Graphics ('Asset') content sections with a new _renderCollectionPicker(exp,key,iconFallback,accept), synthesizing two already-proven precedents (Frame's grid-of-existing-options pattern, _assetUploadRow's own upload/replace/remove row, unchanged and still funneling through _storeUploadedAsset/AssetStore.put()) rather than inventing a new mechanism. Picking an existing Collection entry writes that entry's own .ref string back onto imageSrc/graphicSrc through the exact same updateExperienceProperty() write path a fresh upload already uses -- the identical string, so AssetStore/ThemeRegistry/_syncUniversalContent never need to know Collection exists. The 'reuse' grid is shown only when at least one matching-kind Collection entry exists (never an empty, confusing grid on a brand-new World); Graphics' pre-existing mutual-exclusion rule (picking an image clears graphicShape) is preserved for the 'reuse' path too, not just fresh upload. Two real, confirmed bugs were found and fixed during verification, neither invented for this ticket: (1) a genuine, pre-existing World Builder app bug -- showTemplates() only ever called renderTemplateGrid() once, at boot, never again on later visits to Screen 2; since a template card's own click handler marks itself wb-busy and never clears that class on its success path (the Template Rule replaces it with the Workspace immediately), a SECOND 'Create New World -> pick the same template' in one page session silently did nothing at all -- no new Project, Screen 2 just stayed put, with zero visible error. Fixed by rebuilding the grid fresh (renderTemplateGrid()) every time showTemplates() runs, so there is never a stale card left over from an earlier World to hit that guard. (2) A verification-script bug, not an app bug -- ProjectStore.list() has always sorted newest-first ('My World Projects always leads with whatever the creator touched most recently'), so a naive list[list.length-1].id picks the OLDEST Project, not the just-created one; fixed to list[0].id. Verified via a comprehensive Playwright suite (28/28) driving the real UI end to end: Image-section reuse writes the same ref via a real rendered-grid click, never spawns a duplicate entry, and the plain Upload/Remove row still works unchanged; Graphics-section mutual exclusion holds across all three real paths (a fresh glyph-rasterization upload, picking a Shape, and now reusing an existing Collection entry) -- each correctly clears whichever of graphicShape/graphicSrc the OTHER path had set, with Remove confirmed to only ever clear the referencing field, never the Collection registry entry itself (Builder-only delete is Phase 3's own, separate action); and a genuinely brand-new second World (created via the just-fixed showTemplates() rebuild) correctly shows zero Collection entries and no reuse grid at all. Full regression: both goldenBuild.js suites (World Builder v1 and v2, 30/30 each) pass unchanged, confirming this phase touches neither compile/validate/publish pipeline; scene_dropdown_repro3.js (14/14, exercising Experience CRUD/graduation/attachment/Host Here dropdown heavily) passes unchanged. No Theme Contract/Engine V2 Scene Model/Creator Governing Rules change; tools/world-builder/ (v1) and root Studio are completely untouched -- confined entirely to tools/world-builder-v2/js/worldBuilderApp.js. Phases 3 (Manage Collection screen + Builder-only delete UI), 4 (compile-time dedup in builder.js -- where 'reduces data load' is actually realized), 5 (Creator-facing availability metadata in the compiled package), and 6 (Creator-side 'From This World' browsing UI) remain named, not-yet-started increments -- see /root/.claude/plans/witty-floating-thimble.md for the complete phased rollout.
